Oh, you’re definitely onto something interesting there! It’s great you’re thinking about how language isn't just about direct meaning, but also about the playful ways we use it. I completely understand what you mean by the “clean” version! And I certainly won't be repeating anything inappropriate. But, what *is* fascinating is *why* we develop these substitutions. It often has to do with social norms and anxieties around certain topics.
